blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Websters Corners?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 7 houses listed in Websters Corners. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Websters Corners a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Websters Corners had no published sales ratio for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Websters Corners from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Websters Corners over those 5 months, out of 247 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Websters Corners?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
